name: Pressure vessels, reactors and cryogenic tanks
aliases: Pressure vessels, reactors and cryogenic tanks
applications: storage of LPG, ammonia and chlorine
principle: Vessels hold gas or liquid at a pressure different from ambient; the wall carries the load in tension. Design is governed by codes such as ASME BPVC and the EU Pressure Equipment Directive.

process_steps.name: Design to a code (ASME BPVC, EN 13445)
Hydrostatic test at 1.5 times working pressure
Inspector signs off; nameplate with U-stamp
